scientific_limitations: Simple connected unicyclic graphs, positive edge weights, zero onsite energies and off-cycle root at graph distance at least one. Flux exceptions remove the leading contrast. No multi-cycle generalization; possible uninspected stronger prior theorem.
title: Off-cycle root distance controls the first magnetic-flux signature in weighted unicyclic quantum walks
